I see them on TV, and they'll say something about the economy, and I know they're sending a message, a coded warning just for me. It's been going on for months now, this feeling that everyday things are specifically about my life.

I was convinced I had some grand mission to accomplish. That whirlwind lasted about a month, maybe a bit more. But even after that feeling subsided, these messages, these signs from the TV and radio, they never stopped. They’re still here, clear as day. I get out, do my shopping, pay my bills, and talk to my neighbor, Martha, like always. My day-to-day routine hasn't really changed, aside from always watching for new messages.
